verdict.rationale: Omarchy is an opinionated Arch/Hyprland desktop distribution bundling terminal tools, dev environment installers, and AI agent harnesses — it is not a platform or service that exposes APIs/SDKs for third parties to build against. The evidence (CLI, dev environment installers, agent bundling) reflects OS configuration, not an SDK offering, and probes for API/SDK artifacts (openapi.json, llms.txt) returned 404, confirming no such surface exists.
